# NACD International | The National Association for Child Development

> > NACD provides individualized neurodevelopmental programs addressing cognitive development, learning disabilities, and special needs across all ages from preschool through adulthood.

NACD International specializes in neurodevelopmental intervention programs using parent training, individualized assessment, and brain-based strategies. The organization serves children with conditions ranging from autism and ADHD to dyslexia and cerebral palsy, as well as gifted learners and typical children seeking to reach their full potential.

## Key Topics

- Neurodevelopmental Assessment
- Parent Training
- Individualized Intervention Programs
- Cognitive Development
- Neuroplasticity
- Down Syndrome
- Autism Spectrum
- ADHD/ADD
- Dyslexia
- Learning Disabilities
- Cerebral Palsy
- Brain Injury
- Special Needs
- Educational Strategies
- Child Development

## Core Programs by Condition

- [Autism Spectrum Programs](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help/autism-spectrum): Autism spectrum intervention programs with individualized assessment and parent support.
- [Down Syndrome Programs](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help/down-syndrome): Individualized neurodevelopmental programs for children with Down syndrome.
- [Dyslexia Programs](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help/dyslexia): Dyslexia intervention addressing root neurological causes with individualized assessment.
- [ADD & ADHD Programs](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help/attention-deficit-disorders-add-adhd): ADD/ADHD programs addressing underlying neurodevelopmental needs beyond diagnosis.
- [Brain Injury Programs](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help/brain-injured): Neurodevelopmental programs for brain-injured children beyond standard therapies.
- [Cerebral Palsy Programs](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help/cerebral-palsy): Cerebral palsy programs targeting motor and cognitive development with brain-based intervention.
- [Learning Disabilities Programs](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help/learning-disabilities): Learning disabilities remediation addressing root causes with individualized intervention.
- [Genetic Disorders Programs](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help/genetic-disorders): Programs for genetic disorders including Down and Williams syndrome with neuroplasticity focus.

## Age-Specific & Population Programs

- [Preschool Neurodevelopmental Programs](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help/preschool): Early childhood programs providing targeted assessment and parent training for preschoolers.
- [Homeschool Programs](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help/homeschooling): T.H.E. Targeted Home Education program for homeschooling families with customized plans.
- [School Collaboration Programs](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help/schools): School partnership programs complementing classroom learning with individualized support.
- [Programs for Gifted & Accelerated Children](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help/highly-capableadvanced-students): Programs for gifted and advanced learners reaching full potential with individualized strategies.
- [Programs for Typical Children](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help/typical-children): Programs helping typical children thrive through neurodevelopmental assessment and training.
- [Adult Neurodevelopmental Programs](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help/adults): Adult programs improving cognitive function and quality of life through neurodevelopmental strategies.

## About NACD

- [Home](https://www.nacd.org): NACD homepage: neurodevelopmental programs for children from special needs to gifted.
- [Who We Are](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-are): NACD organization overview describing neurodevelopmental intervention philosophy and services.
- [Who We Help](https://www.nacd.org/who-we-help): Overview of NACD services for conditions including autism, ADHD, dyslexia, brain injury.
- [NACD Staff & Key Personnel](https://www.nacd.org/nacd-staff-key-personnel): NACD leadership and staff directory including Robert Doman and key personnel.
- [NACD Ambassadors](https://www.nacd.org/nacd-ambassadors): Ambassador families sharing success stories and advocating for NACD's child development mission.

## Services & Support

- [Where to Go for Help](https://www.nacd.org/where-to-go-for-help): Service locations, international chapters, and teleconference scheduling information.
